title: ElytraAvionics
description: Aviation inspired HUD instruments, terrain warnings, and altitude callouts for Elytra flight
body:
## About

ElytraAvionics adds aviation inspired HUD instruments and GPWS style warnings to Minecraft elytra flight.

Track your speed, receive altitude callouts, and get terrain warnings while flying to improve situational awareness and avoid crashes.

## Features

- Ground speed HUD indicator
- Pull Up terrain warning
- Altitude callouts
- HUD only displays while wearing an elytra

## Planned Features

- Heading indicator
- Minimap with configurable flight routes
- Configurable HUD customization

## Feedback

Found a bug or have a suggestion?  
Open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/jrmc-dev/ElytraAvionics/issues/new).
